summary: iRhythm Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a definitive merger agreement to acquire Vital Connect, Inc. The acquirer is iRhythm Technologies, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of iRhythm, with Merger Sub merging into Vital Connect. Aggregate consideration is $237.5 million in cash plus $50 million in iRhythm common stock, subject to customary adjustments, for all outstanding equity. Target stock options and out-of-the-money warrants are cancelled. A portion is held in escrow for adjustments and indemnification. The deal is expected to close by end of 2026, subject to conditions including stockholder approval. Watch for regulatory and closing conditions; risk-arb focuses on deal timeline and stock consideration volatility.
